title: 5 Proven Tips to Go Viral on TikTok in 2025
summary: TikTok has changed from just a trending app for short, catchy videos to one of the most influential social media platforms in the world. Now, in 2025, TikTok has almost 1.6 billion active users. But, TikTok isn’t just a place for trends; it’s an app that holds the foundations of careers for thousands of content creators. Standing out on this platform with such a large user base doesn’t just take luck. In order to ensure your content is reaching a wide audience, you’ll need to first understand what’s working right now in 2025.
